workflow.name: cs_auto_diag
workflow.description: 写 .cs 后自动跑 cs_diag，仅当含 [ERROR] 时注入诊断（after_tool 钩子；需先 ensure_lsp('csharp') 装配 csharp-lsp）

node.title: code
code
node.code: async def main(args) -> dict: diag = args.params.get("diag") or "" has_error = "[ERROR]" in diag return {"inject": has_error, "result": diag}
